QuestInfo.name: [Alliance Mission] Expedition Mission - Giant Monster's Energy
QuestInfo.0: A mysterious and ominous energy flows out of the Void Current, sapping you of your will to persevere. At least once, overcome 3 stages of terror emanating from the giant monster and report to #p3003564#.
QuestInfo.1:
A mysterious and ominous energy flows out of the Void Current, sapping you of your will to persevere. At least once, overcome 3 stages of terror emanating from the giant monster and report to #p3003564#.

#bAs you eliminate monsters, horrific monsters will appear along with the energy from the giant monster.
Defeat all of the horrific monsters and the giant monster's ominous energy will disappear. Then you'll have persevered through 1 stage of terror.#k
QuestInfo.2: You overcame the terror the giant monster radiates and completed the Expedition mission.

default.0: The longer you fight that giant monster and overcome its terrifying influence, the stronger it gets. It'll take everything you've got to beat it once it reaches higher levels.
